My research focuses on developing residual-based theory and statistical methods for detecting structural breaks in nonstationary multivariate time series models. I conduct this research under the supervision of [Prof. Benjamin Holcblat](https://www.uni.lu/fdef-en/people/benjamin-holcblat/) at the University of Luxembourg, in collaboration with [Prof. Steffen Grønneberg](https://www.bi.no/en/about-bi/employees/department-of-data-science-and-analytics/steffen-gronneberg/) at BI Norwegian Business School.
